name: Greymond, Avacyn's Stalwart — Humans have the two chosen abilities
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "Humans you control have each of the chosen abilities" produced nothing. "Choose two abilities from among …" is a choice like a chosen colour (setChosenAbilities, a dropdown of the pairs); the chosen pair is written into the sentence. First strike and lifelink chosen: the Human has both and not vigilance.
